invariants.rationale: If element is non-null, its name is accessed; method will call getName() if not null.
The method iterates over element.getChildrenByName("property") when element is non-null.
The method accesses properties (e.g., puts to it) if element is non-null.
The method uses properties unconditionally (e.g., passes it to other methods), so it is expected to be non-null.
If element.getName() equals "properties", it must also be non-null.
